name: § 1, point o – 48
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy on the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly
part_text: (o) work towards achieving permanent seats for countries from under-represented regions of the world in the UNSC, in the context of a future consensual reform of that body in order to make it more democratic and representative; work towards achieving a permanent seat for the EU in every multilateral forum to cement the EU’s role as an interlocutor with third countries;
